title: Notice — The Delinquency Uplift on a Lateness Charge, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Notice — The Delinquency Uplift on a Lateness Charge, Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

Where a lateness on a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan has run on, the charge for it is raised by a delinquency uplift worked out as a share of the base charge.

| The lateness | The delinquency uplift |
|---|---|
| The days the lateness is assessed over have reached the term's delinquency threshold, **and** the missed due date falls in an earlier whole month than the handling date | This desk's delinquency share of the base charge, that share being **30 percent**, the figure rounded to the cent |
| Those days have passed the term's grace period but have not reached the term's delinquency threshold | This desk's opening delinquency share of the base charge, that share being **10 percent**, the figure rounded to the cent |
| Any other case | No delinquency uplift is added |

The first row needs both of its conditions: days that have reached the delinquency threshold on a missed due date falling in the same whole month as the handling date do not reach it, and — those days having reached the threshold rather than stopping short of it — do not reach the second row either, so no uplift is added.

## Figures by term

| Term | Grace period, calendar days | Delinquency threshold, calendar days past due |
|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 3 | 30 |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 3 | 30 |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 5 | 30 |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 5 | 30 |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 7 | 30 |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 7 | 30 |

The delinquency threshold stands at 30 calendar days past due on every promotional term.

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

On a plan written on the 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan, whose grace period is 5 calendar days and whose delinquency threshold is 30, with a base charge of 32.00 USD:

- Days assessed over standing at 40, the missed due date falling in an earlier whole month than the handling date: the uplift is 30 percent of 32.00 USD, that is 9.60 USD.
- Days assessed over standing at 12: past the grace period of 5 but short of the threshold of 30, so the uplift is 10 percent of 32.00 USD, that is 3.20 USD.
- Days assessed over standing at 3: within the grace period, so no uplift is added.
